description: Basic data generation quality evaluation: schema validity and structured output checks.

cases.prompt: Generate a JSON object representing a person with fields: name (string), age (integer), email (string). Output only the JSON.
Generate a JSON array of 3 programming languages, each with fields: name (string) and year (integer). Output only the JSON.
Write a one-paragraph summary of the Rust programming language. Focus on its memory safety guarantees and zero-cost abstractions.

expected.rubric: The summary should mention memory safety without garbage collection, ownership system, and zero-cost abstractions. It should be factually accurate and well-structured.
